macro_cross_check: Source publishes 642 cal / 75.3 carbs / 58.5 protein per serving over 4 servings. Recomputed at source scale over all 22 lines: about 3070 cal, 202.6 g protein, 323 g carbs total = 767 cal / 50.7 P / 80.7 C per serving. Protein is 13.4% under the source's figure - inside the 15% bar but the widest gap in this batch, and it is a PRODUCT difference, not a portion one: the main protein is stated by the source in grams (400 g diced breast = 100 g raw per serving, no each-weight assumption available to get wrong), and the shortfall sits in the two cheeses, where US 1/3-less-fat cream cheese carries 2 g protein per 28 g against a UK light cream cheese's roughly 3 g, and Kraft 2% cheddar is leaner in protein per 100 g than a UK 30%-reduced-fat block. The same substitution explains calories running 19.5% high (US 1/3-less-fat cream cheese is about 250 cal/100 g against UK Philadelphia Light at about 165). Carbs agree at +7%. In band: 767 cal (450-800, though close to the ceiling) and 50.7 g protein (>= 40).
